Etihad Guest Miles offer | Emirates NBD
عربي

Up to 1 million Etihad Guest Miles, now within your reach

This season, your savings and spends can take you places. Bring more of your banking together to unlock a travel bundle that rewards you every step of the way.

Transfer your salary, grow your savings and spend with your Etihad Guest Visa Elevate Credit Card to earn up to 1 million Etihad Guest Miles.

How your Miles add up:

Transfer a salary of  30,000 or more

Up to 100,000 Miles

Maintain a balance of  250,000 or more

Up to 500,000 Miles

Spend with your Etihad Guest Visa Elevate Credit Card

Up to 400,000 Miles

The offer is valid from 1 September 2026 to 28 February 2027.

This offer is valid for Abu Dhabi residents only. Customers will need to enrol to participate in this offer.

Click here to view the terms and conditions.

Apply now and have us call you

This offer is valid for customers who opened their accounts on or after 1 September 2026.
This offer is valid for Abu Dhabi residents only.
